title: Family→tier-table manifest rule is a string recipe in setup.familyDriverManifest and cmd/evolve/model_tier_resolver.go — one bridge.FamilyManifest seam
summary: Architecture review of the 2026-09-09 codex cutover (HIGH): 'which manifest owns a family's tier table' is composed by string concatenation (BaseCLI+"-tmux") in setup.familyDriverManifest and the advisor clamp probe (cmd/evolve/model_tier_resolver.go:33). The drivers no longer need it (headless manifests carry an explicit model_tier_map_from pointer since that PR), but the two pre-existing composers still do.
fix: Add bridge.FamilyManifest(family string) (Manifest, error): resolve a BASE family ("codex", "claude", "agy") to the manifest that DECLARES its model_tier_map by scanning ManifestNames() for BaseCLI(name)==family with a declared map (prefer the -tmux transport), so callers stop composing <base>-tmux. NOTE (architecture review 2026-09-09): setup.tierModelsFor receives a BASE family and LoadManifest("claude") has no manifest (only claude-p/claude-tmux), so the facade must scan, not load the family name directly. Point setup.tierModelsFor and cmd/evolve/model_tier_resolver.go at it; delete familyDriverManifest’s switch. Wiring proof: a fixture headless manifest with model_tier_map_from is resolved identically by both callers.
acceptance: No production caller composes a manifest name from BaseCLI+"-tmux" (grep proves it)
setup.tierModelsFor("codex") and the advisor clamp probe resolve through bridge.FamilyManifest
